written.description: Runs a second, independent agent whose only job is to re-exploit what the first one claimed, so a finding is either reproduced or dropped. One self-hosted binary with a local dashboard.

alive.last_commit_message:
docs(readme): clearer self-host vs Cloud path, tagged links, accurate badges (#822)

* docs(readme): clearer self-host vs Cloud path, tagged links, accurate badges

- Add a "Self-host or Cloud" block under the hero and point Cloud CTAs at
  /signup instead of the homepage, so visitors reach the action they want.
- Tag every xalgorix.com and docs link with UTM parameters
  (utm_source=github, utm_medium=readme) so README traffic is measurable.
- Correct stale facts: Go badge 1.24+ -> 1.26+ (go.mod), platform badge
  Linux -> Linux | macOS (install.sh ships both), comparison table rows
  for plans, updates and scheduling.
- Make the privacy statement accurate: nothing is sent to Xalgorix, but
  scan context goes to the configured LLM provider and blind-vuln
  callbacks use public Interactsh unless XALGORIX_INTERACTSH_SERVER is set.
- Add GitHub App, Discussions and Security rows to the Links table.

The sponsor section is unchanged in content and position.
